prompt: A town that decorates itself for a winter festival.

card.name: Frostlight Festival Town

site.text: An ordinary snug town on level ground, laid out around a central festival square

style.text: Cozy winter festival look: snow-dusted roofs, spruce and white wool, lanterns, garlands, red and green banners, warm glowing light

purpose.text: A welcoming town that decorates itself for a winter festival and gathers its people for celebration

card.interpretation: You asked for a town that dresses up for a winter festival. I took the site as a small, flat village around a festival square, the style as a cozy snowy look with lanterns and garlands (Nordic base), and the purpose as a welcoming celebration town. The buildings centre on a festival hall and a decorated tree square, with homes, a few festive shops, a chapel of lights, a sleigh stable and an ice rink.
assumptions: Nordic style used as the base for winter
Location is searched for, since no spot was named

program.notes: Great timber hall facing the square, hung with garlands and lanterns, long feast tables and a big hearth
Open square with a tall decorated spruce, lantern posts, and market stalls
Snow-capped cottages with wreaths on doors, lanterns, and candle-lit windows
Festival cookies and warm drinks, stall at the front
Carved gifts and decorations, colourful window displays
Small shrine with a lit beacon-like lantern tower for the festival
Stores sleighs, hay and decorations for the season
Frozen pond with benches and a warming hut beside it
